pattern.description: In a photoreal 3D render, a rolled yoga mat unrolls/peels open while the product ring rolls along it; a static caption word ('Your') sits centred over the scene.
pattern.why_premium: The product is introduced through a physical, lifestyle-coded action rendered with shallow depth of field and soft daylight, so motion comes from the object itself rather than graphics; the caption stays still to let the prop do the work.

build_hint.gsap: Pre-rendered 3D clip: play the footage layer; overlay caption is static. If recreated in 2.5D, gsap.to('.mat', {scaleX: 1, clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0 0)', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out'}) with the ring gsap.to('.ring', {x: 20, rotation: 30, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.out'}) at the same time.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> for the 3D render; for a 2.5D recreation drive mat reveal and ring x/rotation from one spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) so they move together; caption text has no animation in this burst.

notes: Caption 'Your' (b02) has high changed_share only because the mat moves behind it; its position and opacity look constant, so it is not listed. b03/b04/b05 are background slivers changed by the mat motion. camera.move is none; the scale sum reflects the mat motion, not a push-in.
